comment: The sustain CV sumRange is a level, not a voltage: knob plus CV is clamped to 0-1, which is 0 to 100%. The attack and release CVs are added as seconds directly, so one volt at a full attenuverter adds one second; both are read only at the instant the stage starts, so moving them during a stage changes nothing. Left and right take their channel counts separately. The RESET jack is inside the Toggle-mode branch at Toggler.cpp:164, so it does nothing in Gate mode.
